tasks.label: Deploy Hub to Heroku
tasks.command: git subtree push --prefix hub heroku main

tasks.label: Hub: Edit development credentials
tasks.detail: bin/rails credentials:edit --environment development: opens in a tab, saved encrypted when the tab is closed (needs config/credentials/development.key)

tasks.label: Hub: Edit production credentials
tasks.detail: bin/rails credentials:edit --environment production: opens in a tab, saved encrypted when the tab is closed (needs config/credentials/production.key)
